entity_types.name: Complaint
entity_types.description: A safety-related problem or failure report submitted by a vehicle owner to NHTSA; does not include informal forum posts or dealer service invoices.

entity_types.name: Vehicle
entity_types.description: A specific motor vehicle model and model year; does not include individual components or generic classifications.

entity_types.name: Recall
entity_types.description: An official safety recall campaign issued by a vehicle manufacturer or safety regulator; does not include routine maintenance or voluntary customer service bulletins.

entity_types.name: Component
entity_types.description: A specific mechanical, electrical, or structural vehicle part or subsystem; does not include observable failure symptoms or external damage causes.

entity_types.name: Problem
entity_types.description: An observable failure symptom, operational malfunction, or safety hazard experienced by the vehicle; does not include the physical part itself.

fact_types.description: Identifies an observable failure symptom, operational defect, or hazard reported by the owner in the complaint.
Connects an owner complaint to a specific vehicle part or subsystem mentioned as failing, inspected, or replaced.
Attributes an observed malfunction or symptom directly to the specific vehicle part or assembly experiencing the failure.
Connects an owner complaint to an official safety recall campaign explicitly cited or inquired about in the report.
Links the owner safety complaint directly to the specific vehicle model and year cited in the report.
Associates a component mentioned in a complaint with the vehicle model that the document concerns.
